_note: What both backends send a provider for a given input (server/ai/prompt.ts; PHP Ai\PromptBuilder): the system text from the bundle's prompt, the site's hostels and the day; the few-shot pairs from the bundle's examples; the staff text last, fenced as data. A stub bundle keeps the vectors stable while the real prompts change. A picture read (feature 'photo') sends the reader's prompt alone as the system text and one turn: the picture, then the one fixed line that asks for its words (AI_PICTURE_ASK in src/shared/ai.ts). No hostels, no day, no few-shot.
